---
title: "Resources"
order: 118
---

This module introduces no new regulation, standard, or framework, and no new source was fetched
for it. It crosswalks ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) vocabulary — the
learner's own professional background, never itself cited to a specific AXELOS/PeopleCert
publication anywhere in this curriculum — onto AABB's (Association for the Advancement of Blood
& Biotherapies) own QSE (Quality System Essential) taxonomy and onto the eQMS's (electronic
quality-management system's) own already-built record from `grc-frameworks-and-risk-management`.
The links below are the direct inputs this module maps against, plus the already-verified AABB
page this course's own prior module relied on.

- **[AABB: Updated Quality Systems
  Essentials](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/standards/about-aabb-standards/updated-quality-systems-essentials)**
  — AABB's own current page on the QSE framework, including QSE 3 (Equipment) and QSE 9 (Process
  Improvement), the two QSE themes this module names and maps against without quoting any
  Standards text. The same link `aabb-qse-framework`'s own resources page and
  `the-aabb-assessment-process`'s resources page already verified and used — reused here rather
  than re-checked from scratch. Use it to confirm each QSE's theme and scope in AABB's own words;
  don't cite a standard number from it.

- **[The AABB quality system at a
  glance](../../quality-system-essentials/aabb-qse-framework/index.qmd)** — the
  `quality-system-essentials` module that first named and listed all ten QSEs, including QSE 3 and
  QSE 9, the two this module's crosswalks map onto. Read it for the full taxonomy and the
  discipline of naming a QSE by theme without quoting AABB's own Standards text — the exact
  pattern this module follows.

- **[Risk Management Frameworks Side by
  Side](../../grc-frameworks-and-risk-management/risk-frameworks-side-by-side/index.qmd)** and
  **[Categorize and Select
  Controls](../../grc-frameworks-and-risk-management/categorize-and-select-controls/index.qmd)**
  — the two `grc-frameworks-and-risk-management` modules this module's running artifact draws its
  eQMS facts from: that it holds CAPA records, document control, and internal-audit logs across
  all three sites, replacing an older BECS (Blood Establishment Computer Software)-adjacent
  tracking tool and, at Fairview specifically, a paper-based process. Read either one for the
  eQMS's full categorization reasoning and control-family selection, which this module references
  by name but doesn't redevelop.

- **[Staying Validated: Changes, Patches, and Periodic
  Review](../../csv-and-becs/validated-state-lifecycle-and-patching/index.qmd)** — the
  `csv-and-becs` module this module's CMDB crosswalk names, reference only, for BECS's own
  validation lifecycle (a validated state, periodic review, and revalidation triggered by change)
  — the fuller version of the qualification concept a plain CMDB entry doesn't carry by default.

- **[ITIL-to-QSE Crosswalk: Change and
  Problem](../itil-to-qse-crosswalk-change-and-problem/index.qmd)** — this course's own module 1,
  for the same honest-mapping method this module continues (same discipline, narrower or stricter
  gate — never "basically identical") and for the `change-control-for-regulated-systems` and
  `capa-root-cause-to-effectiveness` references this module's QSE 9 crosswalk builds on without
  re-quoting.
